name: Flag AI replies in Slack when tool actions did not finish

parameters.content:
## Flag AI replies in Slack when tool actions did not finish

### How it works
For teams whose AI agents send, refund, book or delete things, then say it is done. A webhook receives the agent's final reply plus a tool log, or a saved n8n execution with a node map. A Code node, with no AI key, finds completed action claims (sent, refunded, all set, refund processed) and promised consequences (you'll see the credit in 3-5 days, a confirmation email is on its way). Claims bind to the call for the same order, recipient or amount. An HTTP 200 body that reports failure is not finished; a batch with some failed items is partial. A claim needs a finished result with a provider id (S3). Unsupported pay or delete claims are stop-ship. Payments retried after a timeout with no idempotency key: review. Gaps go to Slack; every check is logged to Google Sheets. Conditional, plain future and "couldn't" wording are not claims.

Try it first: click Execute workflow on Run Sample Cases. Seven built in cases run with no accounts.

Limits: it cannot recall a sent message. Targets depend on the tool log or node map. English wording only.

### Setup
1. In Config, set the Slack Incoming Webhook URL, spreadsheet ID, sheet name, the default node map, the failure marker list and the partial rules.
2. Connect Google Sheets OAuth2 on Append to Google Sheet.
3. Add this header row to the sheet tab: timestamp, receivedAt, source, verdict, stopShip, claims, gaps, gapRate, reply, report.
4. Activate, POST a test payload to `/webhook/say-do-check`, and confirm the JSON response.

### Customization
Edit `notifyOn` (`gaps`, `stop_ship` or `always`), the default node map, the failure marker list and the partial rules. Call this webhook after the agent node finishes.

## 1. Receive and check
The webhook accepts a reply plus a tool log, or a saved execution plus a node map. All user values live in Config.

## 0. Try it with no accounts
Click Execute workflow on Run Sample Cases. Seven built in cases go through the same check and stop at Sample Results, which shows each verdict next to the expected one. Slack and Sheets are not called.

## 2. Return the verdict
Responds with pass, review or stop_ship, the findings and the text report, so a calling workflow can hold a send.

## This is a check, not a recall
It flags a finished reply. It cannot pull back a message that already went out. Run it before you send.

nodes.name: Warning: This does not unsay a sent message

parameters.content:
## 3. Review gaps in Slack
Posts only when Config.notifyOn matches (gaps by default, or stop_ship, or always).

## 4. Log every check
Adds one row per request: pass, review or stop_ship, with the report text.

nodes.name: Config
nodes.notes:
Edit these values before activating.
slackWebhookUrl: Slack Incoming Webhook URL for your review channel (keep it private).
spreadsheetId: the ID from your Google Sheet URL.
sheetName: tab that receives the log rows.
notifyOn: when to post to Slack. Use gaps (any unsupported claim or review reason), stop_ship (only pay or delete gaps), or always.
sourceLabel: written to the sheet when the payload has no source field.
defaultNodeMap: JSON that names the reply node and each action node, used when the payload sends an n8n execution and no nodeMap of its own. See Setup for the shape.
reviewUnsafeRetries: true sends a pay, send, ship or create order call that timed out and then succeeded on a retry without a shared idempotency key to review, because it may have run twice. Set false to only list it under duplicates.
partialRules: JSON with countPairs ([success field, failure field] pairs such as created and failed) and itemArrays (lists such as results or items whose entries carry status, ok or error). A batch with some failed items is graded partial, so a claim that it all went out is sent for review.
failureMarkers: JSON list of body fields that mean the tool did not finish, even when HTTP is 200. The default list covers ok false, success false, status error or failed, a present error field, and a nonempty errors list. Replace the list to match your APIs. An empty list turns off body checks; HTTP 4xx or 5xx and a failed status string still count.

parameters.responseBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ version: $json.version, verdict: $json.verdict, error: $json.error, stopShip: $json.stopShip, claims: $json.claims, gaps: $json.gaps, partials: $json.partials, gapRate: $json.gapRate, findings: $json.findings, duplicates: $json.duplicates, reviewReasons: $json.reviewReasons, disclosures: $json.disclosures, calls: $json.calls, report: $json.report, reply: $json.reply, source: $json.source }) }}

nodes.name: Post Gaps to Slack
nodes.notes: Posts to the Slack Incoming Webhook URL set in Config, so no Slack app credential is needed.

nodes.name: Append to Google Sheet
nodes.notes: Connect Google Sheets OAuth2. Spreadsheet ID and tab come from Config. Header row: timestamp, receivedAt, source, verdict, stopShip, claims, gaps, gapRate, reply, report

nodes.name: Sample Cases
nodes.notes: Seven built in cases with their expected verdicts. No accounts needed.

nodes.name: Sample Results
nodes.notes: One row per sample case. matchesExpected should be true on every row.
